comparison_note: Current and previous are independently measured exported models, identified by SHA-256. Historical measurements are retained under historical and do not describe the current served asset. Panel gaps are modeling constraints, not verified Ford manufacturing tolerances.

assembly_corrected_a391343.label: Assembly-corrected model from commit a391343, replaced by the exterior rebuild
assembly_corrected_a391343.measurement_method: World-space vertex measurements on a losslessly Draco-decoded copy of the final served GLB. The SHA-256 identifies the compressed served asset.
assembly_corrected_a391343.intersection_check_scope: Surveyed hood, painted front fender panels, headlight lenses, and grille frame, including hood motion at the listed angles. This is not a complete all-part collision or engineering validation.

offroad_angles_deg.method: model/exterior/check_offroad_angles.py: tangent lines from each tire (radius 0.4635 m) to the lowest body points; tires, wheels, brakes, cabin, door cards and suspension excluded

exterior_comparison.reference: Ford 2027 F-150 Raptor visualizer, Ruby Red, 36 native 2160 × 926 views
exterior_comparison.method: Upper-body silhouette overlap uses the intersection divided by the union of the projected model and Ford render above the 0.93 m centerline cut. The thin antenna and ground shadows are excluded. Edge distances are symmetric and measured in the native 2160 × 926 images.
